name: inquiryCode
description: Reference code for the inquiry, e.g. INQ-0001-08-26

name: firstName
description: Their first name

name: lastName
description: Their last name

name: greetingName
description: Their first name, or their full name when only that is known

name: email
description: Their email address

name: phone
description: Phone number, when they gave one

name: country
description: Country of residence they selected

name: adults
description: Number of adults travelling

name: children
description: Number of children travelling

name: totalTravelers
description: Adults and children together

name: travellersSummary
description: The party in one phrase, e.g. '2 adults and 1 child'

name: preferredStartDate
description: The date they would like to start, formatted for reading

name: preferredEndDate
description: The date they would like to finish, formatted for reading

name: preferredDatesSummary
description: Both dates in one phrase, or the single one they gave

name: preferredDurationDays
description: How many days they asked for

name: budgetCategory
description: The comfort level they chose, e.g. MID_RANGE

name: budgetCategoryLabel
description: The same, written for a customer to read, e.g. 'Mid-range'

name: tripType
description: Private, group and so on

name: tripTypeLabel
description: The same, written for a customer to read

name: interests
description: What they said they are interested in, comma separated

name: destinations
description: Parks and places they named, comma separated

name: specialRequests
description: Anything they asked for specifically

name: message
description: What they wrote in their own words

name: source
description: Which form or channel it arrived through

name: preferredLocale
description: Language they were browsing in

name: inquiryDate
description: When they submitted it, formatted for reading

name: replyWithinHours
description: The reply commitment the website makes, in hours

name: itineraryName
description: Name of the itinerary they were looking at

name: itineraryCode
description: Its reference code

name: itineraryUrl
description: Public link to it on the website, so they can look again while they wait

name: itineraryTotalDays
description: How many days that itinerary runs

name: itineraryTotalNights
description: How many nights

name: itineraryStartLocation
description: Where it starts

name: itineraryEndLocation
description: Where it ends

name: itineraryDescription
description: Its summary paragraph

name: whatsappUrl
description: A wa.me link to the office WhatsApp, for somebody who would rather not wait for email
